Name: Budgies (Bird Skins or BFAV version)
Author: StormDrakon
Description:
[b][center][color=#ff7700][size=5]Welcome to BUDGIES![/size][/color][/center][/b][center]
[u]-This mod is made for Adopt and Skin or Better Farm Animal Variety-
[/u][/center]


These little birds will wander around your farm, eat all your stuff, and screech while you are trying to sleep. Sounds fun? Of course it is!
[u][center][/center]


[/u][b][u]Installation Guide for AdoptnSkin:[/u]
﻿1.[/b] Install SMAPI and Adopt&Skin
﻿[b]2.[/b] Run the game at least once to make sure there are no existing problems
﻿[b]3.[/b] Download the Budgies! version and drag and drop the skins folder from the download into ﻿your adopt&skin folder (usually located in Stardew Valley\Mods\AdoptSkin\assets)
﻿[b]4.[/b] Change the [b]"##"'s[/b] in the names of the budgie .png files to numbers that are not currently in use by other skins
﻿[b]5.[/b] Use console commands from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt&Skin[/url] to test if the .pngs were installed correctly
﻿[b]6.[/b] Buy a few chickens and enjoy!! (you can always re-name the .pngs to fit with void chickens/ blue chickens or ducks if that is what you prefer)[u]

[/u][b][u]Installation Guide for BFAV Budgies:
[/u] ﻿1.[/b] Install SMAPI and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3296?tab=files]BFAV[/url]﻿
﻿[b]2.[/b] Run the game at least once to make sure there are no existing problems
﻿[b]3.[/b] Download the BFAV Budgies version and drag and drop the BFAV Budgies folder from the download into ﻿your Stardew Valley\Mods
﻿[b]4.[/b] Upon making a Big Coop a new animal will become available from Marine's Ranch: the Budgie! Four different varieties to love!

Behavior of BFAV Budgies:
﻿Budgies take four days to mature into an adult and once a full adult they will forage for fruits and seeds, leaving behind anything that they haven't eaten. Balance-wise I am not sure how this will work as I've set them to "find" treats once every four days. This might be a tad broken in terms of progression? Let me know how it feels and I will try to re-balance the mod.
﻿Note: As rare morphs Albino and Melanistic (Dark) Budgies have a very low chance to find some interesting seeds!

[u]

[/u]Thank you for checking out this page. This is my first attempt at posting anything on Nexus and my first try at sprite sheet artwork. Any comments are appreciated!



Note: [s]once I figure out how the modding works in Stardew I might mess around and update the mod to include a Content Patcher or Custom Farm Animal support. For now, just skins for Adopt&Skin since I do not have a lot of experience modifying xnb files. 

[/s]^Just updated the mod to include a Better Farm Animal Variety implementation (the unofficial update file)


-Feel free to use the skins in a mod pack, just be sure to credit the art back to me. Thank you!-

Downloads.Description: PNG files for Adopt n Skin for the Four Budgie skins (Albino, Melanistic, Blue, Yellow versions of the budgies included as well as the baby sprites)
Add this file to Stardew Valley\ Mods folder to enable a new creature, the budgie, in the ranch shop. (Must also have Better Farm Animal Variety installed)

Manifest.Name: BFAVBudgies
Manifest.Description: Adds Budgies (parakeets) to purchasable farm animals using BFAV.
